_about: Region-neutral change catalogue. Each change maps to an entry in every region pack. kind: cmc, labeling, efficacy or admin (decides the submission type). scope: all, small (chemical drugs), bio, sterile. evidence: ids from evidence.json.

groups.label: Biologics: cell banks, purification, viral safety

changes.title: Move drug product manufacturing to a different site
